claim_text.S:
To SKY CUBE HK (recall 26698),

I am writing about the CuberShop Magnetic Stickerless Speed Cube, model YJ MGC 5x5,
recalled by CPSC on August 13, 2026 because the packaging included loose high-powered
magnets that can be swallowed.

I bought one on May 12, 2025 on Amazon.com for $22.99. That date falls inside the sold
window in the notice (April 2025 through June 2025) and the price falls inside the
stated range of $20.00 to $25.00.

The loose magnets have been taken away from the children and thrown away. A photograph
of the disposed magnets is attached, as the notice requires. I am requesting the $5
refund.

Purchase record and the matching notice are attached as evidence bundle d44be80a21648d90.

Kamal
Pullback case d44be80a21648d90

L.S: The recalled magnetic cubes violate the mandatory standard for toys because the cubes were packaged with loose high-powered magnets, posing an ingestion hazard to children. When high-powered magnets are swallowed, the ingested magnets can attract each other, or other metal objects and become lodged in the digestive system. This can result in perforations, twisting, and/or blockage of the intestines, blood poisoning and death.

title.S: CuberShop Magnetic Speed Cubes Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys; Imported by SKY CUBE HK

claim_text.S:
To Walmart (recall 26726),

I am writing about the Mainstays nine-drawer fabric dresser recalled by CPSC on
August 27, 2026 for tip-over and entrapment hazards under the STURDY Act.

I bought one on September 12, 2024 at Walmart for $79.00. That date falls inside the
sold window in the notice (September 2023 through March 2026) and the price falls
inside the stated range of $64.00 to $96.00.

The dresser is not anchored to a wall and is now in a room my children cannot reach.
I am requesting the full refund described in the notice and will return the drawers to
a Walmart store and dispose of the frame.

Purchase record and the matching notice are attached as evidence bundle d8a169007b4447c6.

Kamal
Pullback case d8a169007b4447c6

L.S: The recalled dressers are unstable if they are not anchored to the wall, posing tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in risk of serious injuries or death to children. The dressers violate the mandatory safety standard as required by the STURDY Act.
